title: Store test documents as markdown
text: Context The test repository needs a first decision to supersede. Decision Store test documents as markdown files in the repository. Consequences Every change goes through a pull request.

title: Store test documents as markdown with frontmatter
text: Context Test documents need structured metadata. Decision Store test documents as markdown with YAML frontmatter; this replaces ADR-0052. Consequences The CLI validates the frontmatter.

title: Clarify the frontmatter decision
text: Context A wording error in the test decision. Decision Keep markdown with frontmatter; see ADR-0053. Consequences None.

title: Search runs in the app process
text: Context Release v0.2.0 adds search to the app. Decision Search runs in the app process; see CODE:dkmaker-xyz/docs-flow-lab-app/search.txt. Consequences No separate search service.

title: Keep one overview diagram
text: Context The system needs an overview. Decision The overview diagram is the reference: ATT-0001. Consequences Changes to the parts update the diagram.

title: Search runs as a separate service
text: Context Search inside the app process (ADR-0055) cannot keep up with the larger indexes planned for v0.3.0. Decision From v0.3.0, search runs as a separate service next to the app. The app calls it over HTTP. The service keeps its own index and is deployed with the same container base image as the app (TECH-0005). Rollout The service ships with v0.3.0; the in-process search is removed in the same release. Consequences One more service to deploy and monitor. The app no longer holds the search index in memory.

title: Read the documentation in the local viewer
text: Context The overview diagram (ADR-0056) is read most often in the browser. Decision Developers read the documentation with idc365-decisions view . Consequences No hosted site is needed.

title: Repository structure
text: This code repository has two applications under apps/ : apps/web : the web front end, a Node.js package ( package.json ) built into a container image ( Dockerfile ). apps/integration2 : an integration service, a Maven project ( pom.xml ). CI lives in .github/workflows/ ; tech-check.yml runs idc365-decisions tech check on every pull request, so every dependency must be on the approved tech stack. Before changing an application, read its code documentation ( idc365-decisions code show apps/web/ ) and the decisions it links to.

title: marked
text: Use marked renders the Markdown bodies of the documentation to HTML for the documentation site ( idc365-decisions site build , phase 11). Use it only through the CLI's renderer, which turns raw HTML in a body into text and keeps only http(s), mailto, fragment and relative link targets. Why this one Zero runtime dependencies (MIT), maintained, CommonMark and GFM tables. markdown-it needs six packages (argparse, entities, linkify-it, mdurl, punycode.js, uc.micro); micromark over twenty. Sanitizing is done by the renderer itself (no raw HTML at all), so no DOM-based sanitizer such as DOMPurify (which needs jsdom on Node) is needed. Version Pin an exact 18.x version that has been out for at least the cooldown period; 18.1.2 (released 2026-10-26) at the time of approval.
